description: [REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL] Change event settings such as dates or venue. Pass eventId or use the selected event, and supply the fields to change. Returns the event API response; review the current settings first.

attributes.description: Event attributes to merge. Supplied physical venue locations must resolve through Google; venue.googlePlaceId resolves the full address and map coordinates.

confirm.description: [REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL] Pass `true` to execute. This is a programmatic backstop to the description tag. Destructive tools also require your approval through the client.

eventId.description: Event ID. Defaults to active event.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key to replay a recorded successful request; use a new key for a different change.

name: update_event

result.description: The API result when it is a list, scalar or null rather than an object.
